name: parcelparcel
description:
ParcelParcel connects Claude to international parcel shipping. Ask for a quote,
compare carrier options side by side, create and book a shipment, pull the label,
and follow it to delivery — all in one conversation.

What you can do:
- Compare shipping options — get rates, transit times, and products from multiple
  carriers for any origin, destination, and set of parcel dimensions
- Estimate duties and taxes for cross-border shipments before you commit
- Create a draft shipment, review the quote and details, then book it when it's right
- Download PDF shipping labels for booked shipments
- Track any of your shipments, with current status and full event history
- Search your shipment history with filters — by date, status, destination, or reference

Built for businesses that ship parts, samples, and high-value goods across borders,
where getting the right carrier and the right customs paperwork actually matters.
Bookings always go through a draft-and-review step first, so nothing gets booked
without your confirmation.

Requires a (free) ParcelParcel account.

_published_faq.name: How do I add parcelparcel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add parcelparcel to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://services.parcelparcel.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the parcelparcel MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: parcelparcel provides these MCP tools: book_shipment, calculate_admin_rates, compare_shipping_options, create_shipment_draft, estimate_duties_taxes, find_shipments, get_shipment_labels, track_shipment, and whoami.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to parcelparcel?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to parcelparcel in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.
parcelparcel requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
parcelparcel is developed by ParcelParcel. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
